description: Get content analytics including views and engagement metrics. Can analyze a specific article by slug or get top articles by reads.

dateFrom.description: Start date for analytics (ISO format, e.g., 2024-01-01). Defaults to 30 days ago.

dateTo.description: End date for analytics (ISO format, e.g., 2024-12-31). Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of top articles to return (1-50). Only used when slug is not provided.

slug.description: The slug of a specific article to get analytics for. If not provided, returns top articles.

name: get_content_analytics
title: Get Content Analytics
